items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: How would you contrast him with Fats, for instance? With Fats Waller. ... INTERVIEWEE: Hm. I don't know how to classify him.

ctx.x: And, Willie would accompany was good, you know, with her -- really did very well at that. But, as I say, he would, you know, -- he would stride, too, he would --
What I was really wondering was -- about him -- not having heard him. Would you say he was more like Luckey Roberts than Fats Waller, say ?.
Well, I never had a chance, really, to hear Roberts.
